passages.note: Final Senate concurrence vote on SB 770; Wiener is listed as author ('Wiener et al.') and in the Ayes.
passages.actor_quote: Ayes Allen, Archuleta, Ashby, Atkins, Becker, Blakespear, Bradford, Caballero, Cortese, Dodd, Durazo, Eggman, Gonzalez, Laird, Limón, McGuire, Menjivar, Min, Newman, Padilla, Portantino, Roth, Rubio, Skinner, Smallwood-Cuevas, Stern, Umberg, Wahab, Wiener

passages.provision_quote: the Legislature endorses a health care system with unified financing, such as a single-payer health care system, to provide accessible, affordable, equitable, and high-quality health care for all Californians
passages.note: Operative Sec. 1001 directs the Secretary to research and pursue a waiver framework; Sec. 1000(i) states the goal that framework serves.

rows.reasoning: SB 770's operative section directs the Secretary of the California Health and Human Services Agency to 'research, develop, and pursue discussions of a waiver framework' rather than enacting any financing system itself, so it is a study directive, and Wiener authored it and voted Aye on final concurrence. The bill states its own goal — 'the Legislature endorses a health care system with unified financing, such as a single-payer health care system' — which under the study-directive rule (a directive that states its goal) shows direction toward 'Make healthcare free and available to everyone, fully paid for by the public sector' without itself establishing that chair.
